name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse the rice twice and soak it for 15 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a pot and fry the sliced onion until golden.
Add ginger, garlic and the chopped carrot, peas and capsicum. Saute for 3 minutes.
Add the drained rice, 2 cups water and salt. Stir once.
Cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes, then rest 5 minutes before fluffing.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Boil the tomatoes, onion and cashews for 8 minutes, cool and blend to a smooth puree.
Melt butter in a pan, add garlic and fry for 30 seconds.
Pour in the puree with chilli powder, salt and a pinch of sugar. Simmer 10 minutes until the fat separates.
Add cubed paneer and cream, simmer 4 more minutes.
Finish with crushed kasuri methi and serve hot.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt, pepper and chopped coriander.
Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato and green chilli.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan and pour in the mixture.
Cook 2 minutes until the base sets, fold over and cook 1 more minute.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Marinate the chicken with yogurt, turmeric, chilli powder and salt for 20 minutes.
Fry sliced onions in oil until deep brown, then add ginger and garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and pulpy.
Add the chicken and sear on high heat for 5 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup hot water, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Tomato Rasam
steps: Crush the tomatoes and garlic roughly and add to 3 cups water with tamarind pulp and salt.
Add rasam powder and boil for 10 minutes until the raw smell goes.
Stir in cooked toor dal if using and simmer 3 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over the rasam.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, day-old cooked rice so the grains stay separate.
Heat oil on the highest flame and fry chopped garlic for 20 seconds.
Add the julienned carrot, cabbage and capsicum. Stir-fry 3 minutes, keeping them crunchy.
Add the rice, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Toss for 3 minutes.
Finish with chopped spring onion greens.

name: Banana Oats Smoothie
steps: Soak the oats in a little milk for 5 minutes so they blend smoothly.
Add the banana, remaining milk, honey and peanut butter to a blender.
Blend for 45 seconds until creamy and pour into a tall glass.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead the flour with water and a little oil into a soft dough. Rest 20 minutes.
Boil, peel and mash the potatoes. Mix with chopped onion, chilli, coriander, salt and spices.
Roll a ball of dough, place the filling in the centre, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with oil on both sides until golden brown spots appear.
Serve with yogurt or pickle.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight and pressure-cook 5 whistles, or use canned chickpeas.
Fry chopped onion until brown, add ginger-garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder, chilli powder and garam masala. Cook until thick.
Add the chickpeas with a cup of their cooking water. Simmer 12 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy and squeeze lemon over.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Flatten the chicken breast, rub with salt, pepper, lemon juice and a little oil.
Grill on a hot pan for 6 minutes per side, then rest 5 minutes and slice.
Toss torn lettuce, diced tomato, cucumber and onion in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a dressing and pour over.
Top with the sliced chicken and crumbled cheese.

name: Vegetable Upma
steps: Dry-roast the semolina on low heat for 4 minutes until it smells nutty. Set aside.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add onion, ginger and green chilli.
Add the chopped carrot and peas, cook 3 minutes, then pour in 2.5 cups hot water with salt.
When it boils, lower the flame and pour in the semolina in a steady stream while stirring.
Cover and steam 3 minutes until fluffy.

name: Pasta in Tomato Sauce
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until just firm to the bite. Save half a cup of the water.
Blanch and blend the tomatoes into a puree.
Fry sliced garlic and onion in olive oil, add the puree, salt, pepper and chilli flakes.
Simmer 12 minutes until it thickens, then add the pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss well and finish with cheese and torn basil.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the beaten eggs in hot oil, break them up and remove from the pan.
Add more oil, fry garlic and diced carrot for 2 minutes.
Add cold cooked rice, soy sauce, salt and white pepper. Toss on high heat 3 minutes.
Return the egg, add spring onion and toss once more.

name: Palak Dal
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric, salt and 3 cups water for 3 whistles.
Chop the spinach finely and stir it into the hot dal. Simmer 5 minutes.
Temper cumin, garlic and chopped tomato in oil until soft.
Pour the tempering into the dal, simmer 3 minutes and finish with lemon juice.

name: Cheese Vegetable Sandwich
steps: Butter both slices of bread on the inner side.
Layer thin slices of tomato, cucumber, onion and capsicum, sprinkling salt and pepper.
Add the cheese slice and close the sandwich.
Toast in a pan or griller for 3 minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Fish Fry
steps: Make a paste of chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic, salt and lemon juice.
Coat the fish and marinate for 20 minutes in the fridge.
Dust the pieces with rice flour for a crisp crust.
Shallow-fry on medium heat 4 minutes per side until golden.
Fry curry leaves in the same oil and scatter over the fish.

name: Mixed Fruit Bowl
steps: Dice the apple and banana, segment the orange.
Toss everything gently in a bowl with a squeeze of lemon so the apple does not brown.
Top with yogurt, honey and chia seeds.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Cut the potato into cubes and the cauliflower into medium florets.
Fry cumin seeds in oil, add onion and ginger, cook until soft.
Add turmeric, chilli powder and the potato. Cover and cook 6 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and salt, cover and cook 12 minutes on low, stirring gently.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander before serving.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Mash the cooked rice slightly while warm and let it cool.
Mix in the yogurt, milk and salt until creamy.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilli and ginger in oil.
Stir the tempering through and top with pomegranate.

name: Mushroom Stir Fry
steps: Wipe the mushrooms clean and halve them. Do not wash them in water.
Heat oil until shimmering and add the mushrooms in a single layer. Leave them undisturbed 3 minutes to brown.
Add garlic and sliced capsicum, toss 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, pepper and butter, then finish with spring onion.

name: Oats Porridge with Apple
steps: Simmer the oats in milk with a pinch of salt for 6 minutes, stirring often.
Grate half the apple into the pot and dice the rest for the top.
Add cinnamon and honey, cook 2 more minutes.
Serve topped with diced apple and chopped almonds.

name: Rajma Masala
steps: Soak the beans overnight and pressure-cook with salt for 6 whistles until very soft.
Blend the onion, tomato, ginger and garlic into a paste.
Cook the paste in oil for 12 minutes until it darkens and the oil separates.
Add spices, then the beans with their water. Simmer 15 minutes.
Mash some beans against the pan to thicken and garnish with coriander.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Beat the eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a cold pan on low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir slowly and constantly for 3 minutes, taking the pan off heat when still slightly wet.
Toast the bread and pile the eggs on top with cheese and spring onion.

name: Cabbage Poriyal
steps: Shred the cabbage finely.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves and chilli in oil.
Add the cabbage and salt, sprinkle 2 tbsp water, cover and cook 8 minutes on low.
Stir in grated coconut and cook uncovered 2 minutes.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Dice the chicken small and stir-fry in hot oil with salt and pepper until cooked. Remove.
Scramble the egg in the same pan and remove.
Fry the diced carrot and capsicum 2 minutes on high heat.
Add the cold rice, soy sauce and pepper. Toss 3 minutes.
Return the chicken and egg, add spring onion and toss once.

name: Tomato Cucumber Raita
steps: Whisk the yogurt smooth with salt and roasted cumin powder.
Finely chop the cucumber, tomato and onion and squeeze out excess water.
Fold them into the yogurt and chill for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer coarsely with your hands.
Fry chopped onion, chilli and capsicum in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt. Cook until the tomatoes break down.
Add the paneer, toss for 3 minutes on low heat and finish with coriander.

name: Lemon Rice
steps: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool so the grains stay separate.
Fry peanuts in oil until golden, then add mustard seeds, curry leaves, chilli and ginger.
Turn off the heat, add turmeric and salt, then squeeze in the lemon juice.
Pour over the rice and fold gently until evenly coloured.

name: Vegetable Soup
steps: Dice all the vegetables into small even pieces.
Saute garlic and onion in butter for 2 minutes.
Add the rest of the vegetables with 3 cups water, salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes, then thicken with 1 tsp cornflour mixed in cold water if you like.

name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the bananas and whisk with the eggs and milk.
Fold in the flour, cinnamon, a pinch of salt and baking powder. Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Ladle onto a buttered pan on medium-low heat.
Flip when bubbles appear on the surface and cook 1 more minute. Serve with honey.

name: Idli Sambar
steps: Prepare and measure all ingredients, then heat the pan or pot over medium heat.
Add the aromatics and seasonings and temper spices, cook the main ingredients and finish with curry leaves.
Add idli rice and the remaining main ingredients. Cook for 5–10 minutes, stirring as needed.
Add a small amount of water or stock if needed and cook until the ingredients are tender and the flavors are balanced.
Taste for salt and acidity, garnish with curry leaves, and serve hot.
